combo.description: You can also full combo by using R towards your target, then using Q and AA. W onto them, then AA E AA. Finish up with another Q.
When initiating a fight R to your target, then W and AA. Follow up with Q, then AA and E.
When you don't need to gapclose, Q your target then AA. Use W and AA, then E and AA again. Q again once it's off cooldown.
At 5 passive stacks W onto your target, then AA. Use Q, then AA and E to chase or disengage.
Trade with your opponent by using W onto your target, then Q and AA before using E.
Your basic lane trading combo is to W onto your target, then AA, and use Q and E.
